hints.title: Monotonic Bit Addition Bound
hints.text: As an element is bitwise combined into longer subarrays, bits can only turn on from zero to one at most thirty times.

hints.title: Active Result Collection Size
hints.text: The number of distinct bitwise combinations ending at any position is bounded by thirty.

hints.title: Rolling State Transition
hints.text: At each index, form the new active set by taking x bitwise OR with every element in the previous active set and adding x. Accumulate all results into a global set.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Active bitwise OR set contains at most 30 distinct values per index.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all O(N^2) subarrays takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set of total distinct values requires at most 30 * N entries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that bitwise OR is monotonic, capping active suffix set size at 30.
